description: Per-TLD Council Lv6+ attestation gating ICANN CZDS zone-file ingestion. Per ADR-2605262400 W4. Each enabled TLD requires (1) the operator's per-TLD acceptance flag at ~/.etzhayyim/source-acceptance/czds-<tld>.toml AND (2) a Council Lv6+ attestation record under this lexicon. The fetcher refuses to start until both gates pass. The attestation is on-chain visible (PDS-anchored) so the Council decision trail is auditable. Records are immutable; revocation is recorded as a new record with `status = 'revoked'`.

tld.description: TLD slug in lowercase ASCII, no leading dot (e.g. `com`, `org`, `nz`, `xn--p1ai`).

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only `approved` permits ingestion. `revoked` halts new fetches and (per ADR-2605262400 §6 + W4) requires the operator to issue a tombstone in `datasets.jsonl` for any already-pinned shards.

items.description: DID of a Council Seat that voted in favor. ADR-2605192300 §Council protocol: Lv6+ supermajority requires ≥4 of 7 seats.

decidedAt.description: RFC3339 instant of the Council vote.

tier.description: Per-TLD effective tier. The CZDS agreement varies per TLD; some are pure research-use (C), some carry redistribution restrictions that map to D. Tier D zones are admitted only to fleet-internal inference paths AND with stricter Charter Rider §2(c) review.

expectedLicense.description: Free-form slug of the upstream license / TOS clause the Council attested to (e.g. 'czds-research-use', 'czds-com-extended-restrictions'). Stored verbatim from the upstream registration text.

noteCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of a public note explaining the rationale + scope of the per-TLD approval. Recommended for any Tier-D approval and for any TLD where Council members declared a conflict of interest.

expiresAt.description: Optional RFC3339 expiry instant. After this time the fetcher MUST treat the approval as `revoked` and refuse new fetches until a new attestation lands.
